svg.title: Semantic Colour Aliases: OKLCh Reference Hue Ranges
svg.desc: Diagram showing the 360-degree OKLCh hue spectrum and the canonical target hues and boundary ranges for eight semantic colour aliases: Red (target 20°, range 345° to 30°, wrapping across 360°), Orange (target 50°, range 30° to 65°), Yellow (target 90°, range 65° to 110°), Green (target 142°, range 110° to 175°), Cyan (target 195°, range 175° to 220°), Blue (target 255°, range 220° to 280°), Purple (target 315°, range 280° to 340°), and Magenta (target 335°, range 315° to 355°).
svg.text: Semantic Colour Aliases: OKLCh Reference Hue Ranges
